operative_spec.mechanism: A card-v6 entry is a trend-continuation entry: it buys a pullback inside an established 4h tide. Two clocks say independently that such an entry is LATE. The tide clock: the tide it rides has already run long measured against every tide run the home panel has shown up to that bar (its age at the entry bar is in the top trailing quartile, the OLD band). The window clock: the pullback window that armed the entry has stood open for many bars before the trigger came (the arm-to-entry lag is at or above the filed cut). An entry late on either clock joins a move with less of its course ahead of it and with the same structural stop behind it. The claim is that refusing every entry that is late on at least one clock leaves a book whose per-campaign expectancy exceeds the whole book's. The mechanism is declared here and in the contract (:53-54) before this row's interval exists; the book's kept count and mean were already printed by TC11, which is what the label says.

operative_spec.mechanism: Breadth asks whether trend regimes are NEW across the home panel at the moment of an entry. When at least two of the five home assets are in the first half of a tide run (YOUNG or EARLY by the trailing median of all tide runs seen so far), fresh tides are present in the panel and a card-v6 continuation entry rides a regime the market is still establishing. When fewer than two are, the panel's tides are mature, old, unformed or of unknown age, and a continuation entry is late or isolated. The claim is that refusing entries taken when panel-wide youth is absent leaves a book whose per-campaign expectancy exceeds the whole book's. The quantity is near-collinear with the campaign's own tide age by construction (the own asset is one of the five and the assets co-move), which is why the overlap with the OLD refusal is printed beside the row.

operative_spec.mechanism: Inside a 1h value area that the 1h machine reports INSIDE, price that reaches the outer third near an edge tends to rotate back toward the POC and the far edge — the "edges respected" leg TC11-X licensed for the 1h lens at the maker toll and at no other. A limit resting AT the edge is the only entry that pays the maker fee, which is the only toll at which the 1h lens may trade a range. The 5m clock supplies timing and nothing else: an EMA cross toward value near the edge, or a failed 5m excursion beyond it. The trade is falsified by 1h acceptance beyond the faded edge and is bounded in time by the tuning-fit 1h traverse. The hazard is the fill itself — a resting limit is filled preferentially when price is going through it — so the row is judged on the book whose fills require a trade-through and is closed if it clears only when a touch is taken as a fill.

Decision at a 5m close τ on row `k1` of `va_bars_1h` and row `k4` of `va_bars_4h`, the last lens bars with close ≤ τ, read as filed [L-S.3]. PERMISSION: 1h `state == INSIDE` and 4h state neither UNDEFINED nor accepted against the direction (ACCEPTED_BELOW for a long, ACCEPTED_ABOVE for a short), read once at τ [L-S.4]. SETUP: the 5m close's %-of-value against the in-force 1h profile between 0 and 33 inclusive for a long, between 67 and 100 inclusive for a short (33 / 67: contract :87; 0 and 100: the edges of value) [L-S.5]. TRIGGER: the engine EMA12 / EMA89 (:89) of the 5m close crossing in the direction on that bar with the close within 0.25·ATR_1h (:90) of the edge on the value side, OR that close back inside value after the previous 5m close beyond the edge; a double trigger is a swing failure [L-S.6 … L-S.8]. ORDER: one unit at the edge snapped to the tick grid away from the market (a BUY limit floored, a SELL limit ceiled), all geometry frozen at τ; stop by `BK.brk_stop` from the limit — 0.5·ATR_1h (:97) beyond the swing failure's deviation extreme (every 5m low / high since the first close beyond, the return bar included), else from the limit, railed at 1.0·ATR_1h (:98; so R is exactly 1.0·ATR_1h on cross orders); T1 = POC and T2 = far edge − 0.25·ATR_1h (:99) on the grid; REFUSED, with the first reason that holds, when the stop is undefined (`stop_none`), when T1 is not ahead of the limit (`poc_not_ahead`: `d·(n_T1 − n_L) ≤ 0`) or when T2 is not ahead of the limit (`t2_not_ahead`: `d·(n_T2 − n_L) ≤ 0`); T1 void when it lies at or beyond T2, the whole position then exiting at T2; a T1 within the round-trip taker fee of the limit is traded as written and flagged; SKIPPED (`rr_min`) iff `d·(T2 − L) / R < 1.5` (:100); valid for bars t+1 … t+12 (:92); cancelled at a 1h acceptance on the faded side; one resting order and one position per asset, a trigger meanwhile refused, never a replacement [L-S.9 … L-S.14]. FILL: the first valid bar with `low < limit − 1 tick` (long; :94) in exact integer ticks, at the limit price; no fill on a zero-volume bar [L-S.15]. WALK: on the fill bar the stop is tested and no target credited; then per 5m bar: a bar opening at or beyond the stop exits at the open; else the stop, adverse-first, at the stop price; then T1 (half) at its level; then T2 (the rest) at its level, on the same bar if reached; a target fills by the same through-tick rule and books its level with no gap improvement; then at the close the invalidation at a 1h acceptance on the faded side, then the time stop at the fill bar + the tuning-fit 1h traverse in 5m bars, then the corridor end; no trail, no stop move, no add [L-S.17 … L-S.20]. registrations.verdict_rule: verdict_of_record = SUPPORTED iff (a) the cluster-90% CI lower bound (the 5th percentile of the draws) > 0 AND (b) one-sided p <= q ÷ m, exact, AND (c) every declared asset holds at least one row in every arm the ruler reads; else NOT SUPPORTED. m is fixed in every case; a registration closed by its precondition prints 'CLOSED BY PRECONDITION (…) — no number · no test spent', spends no test and never loosens the bar. Bootstrap of record: asset-cluster bootstrap by scripts/tierc12_score.py, T5 primitives, N_BOOT 4000, seed 20261008, sensitivity seed 20260816 beside. At m = 1 the bar does not bind and the bar cell prints '0.10 (not binding at m = 1; decided at the 5th percentile, clause (a))'. THE PRE-NAMED KILL (L-X.9's table, verbatim in content). For each fill book X ∈ {TOUCH, TICK, DEEP}, at the seed of record and this bar, exactly one of three states holds: U(X) = X is not PANEL COMPLETE (clause (c) fails on X; its ruler is undefined; an EMPTY BOOK is the limiting case); C(X) = X is PANEL COMPLETE and clauses (a) and (b) hold on X; F(X) = X is PANEL COMPLETE and (a) or (b) fails on X. D = fewer than 3 of 5 leave-one-asset-out panels of the TICK book exclude zero from above (contract :106; L-X.11). A closure word needs a MEASURED failure: a book whose ruler is undefined is not a failed book. The ten cases, exhaustive, written TICK · D · DEEP · TOUCH → word, qualifier: (1) C · false · C · any → SUPPORTED; (2) C · false · F · any → SUPPORTED, qualifier FILL-SENSITIVE (does not clear under DEEP); (3) C · false · U · any → SUPPORTED, qualifier FILL-SENSITIVE (DEEP PANEL INCOMPLETE); (4) C · true · any · any → NOT SUPPORTED, qualifier LOAO BELOW THE LINE (k/N above; passing when dropped: <assets>; failing when dropped: <assets>); (5) U · any · any · any → NOT SUPPORTED, qualifiers PANEL INCOMPLETE (…) or EMPTY BOOK, and TICK PANEL INCOMPLETE — closure not ruled; (6) F · any · C · any → NOT SUPPORTED; (7) F · any · U · any → NOT SUPPORTED, qualifier DEEP PANEL INCOMPLETE — closure not ruled; (8) F · any · F · C → NOT SUPPORTED — CLOSED, qualifier (clears only under TOUCH); (9) F · any · F · U → NOT SUPPORTED — CLOSED, qualifier TOUCH PANEL INCOMPLETE — "for good" not ruled; (10) F · any · F · F → NOT SUPPORTED — CLOSED FOR GOOD. The words this row can read are exactly five: SUPPORTED, NOT SUPPORTED, NOT SUPPORTED — CLOSED, NOT SUPPORTED — CLOSED FOR GOOD, CLOSED BY PRECONDITION. One test is spent, by the TICK book; TOUCH and DEEP are ruled with the same ruler, seed, draws and bar and can never produce SUPPORTED. The verdict text is the cell (word, qualifiers, label) followed by the fill-sensitivity row, which opens with the fixed sentence "TOUCH and DEEP are fill-model twins, not tests: they are ruled at the family bar without a test of their own and can only qualify a SUPPORTED cell or choose among the failure words; an interval that excludes zero on either is not a result." and prints per fill rule the book's own n, point, interval, p and its state C / F / U, then the two booleans fails_under_deep_too = F(TICK) and F(DEEP), and clears_only_under_touch = F(TICK) and F(DEEP) and C(TOUCH); then the LOAO line k/N with the fixed sentence "the contract reads one-asset dependence by this line (:106); a panel that fails when an asset is DROPPED leans on that asset, a panel that fails while an asset is KEPT is dragged by it"; then the single-trade share of record (no threshold; it decides nothing); then the per-order ladder counts of the TICK ledger and, where the three books' own n are not ordered, the line BOOK-N-NOT-MONOTONE (the books are sequenced separately; their n are not comparable order for order). Printed beside the licence word, deciding nothing: the scorer's collared leaf licence_at_maker_pin — the licence row's edge leg re-derived at Stage D's pinned maker rate from the columns VA_MIRROR.json quotes, labelled "a re-derivation of one leg from printed columns; not a licence"; if its edge_net_h20_at_pin <= 0 the cell carries the qualifier LICENCE EDGE ≤ 0 AT THE PINNED MAKER RATE (X assumed <x> bps round trip; pinned <y>), and the row is still built, scored, and spends its test. Printed beside, deciding nothing: the sensitivity seed, the haircut and all-taker twins and the all-taker haircut twin — with the sentence "No cost twin prices a maker fill's adverse selection — a maker leg carries zero slippage in both. The only proxy in this row is the fill ladder (TICK against DEEP)." —, the tuning and holdout slices, LOAO, both single-trade shares, the literal-bar column, the exact enumeration with SEED-FRAGILE, the month-block twin with TIME-CLUSTER FRAGILE, the drop-OPEN twin with VERDICT RESTS ON OPEN MARKS, the forward strip unscored.
